notes: 1.25.9 alpha - the full batch for Meta Quest operators running HeroVR or HeroVR+VEX (Spawn Point not claimed). adb installs itself on a fresh PC; Devices and OBS panels are on by default with a folder picker for the video pipeline; the session clock starts a new session at zero and survives restarts (pause/resume, anchor); a library that is still starting no longer counts as gone; the background redraw no longer costs half a second per frame; the stall watchdog now measures a real second of lateness instead of its own heartbeat period.
